title: The caesium-133 hyperfine frequency is fixed at 9 192 631 770 Hz
summary: BIPM lists ΔνCs as an exact defining constant. It is the constant tied to the second.
body: BIPM's table of defining constants gives the unperturbed ground-state hyperfine transition frequency of the caesium-133 atom, ΔνCs, as 9 192 631 770 Hz, with no uncertainty. The NIST 2022 CODATA listing is the adjustment published against that system. This card reports the fixed frequency. It does not quote a longer sentence of the form 'the second is the duration of so many periods,' because that full sentence was not on the defining-constants page that was opened.

sources.title: The International System of Units (SI): Defining constants

sources.note: Page opened 2026-11-18. BIPM dates the fixed values to the revision that took effect on 20 May 2019 and cites CGPM Resolution 1 (2018).
